package.description: Headless plugin that handles calls for the RingCentral for Teams embedded app.

en-US.description: Headless plugin that handles calls for the RingCentral for Teams embedded app.
en-US.longDescription:
The RingCentral for Teams embedded app lets you communicate and collaborate with team members by placing phone calls, managing call queues, looking up contacts, and more.
Features include:
- A redesigned user experience in the Teams desktop and web apps.
- Unified contact search across RingCentral and Teams directories.
- Integrated SMS and fax capabilities.
- Notifications for missed calls, new texts, and new voicemails.
- Ability to customize RingCentral phone settings within Teams.
en-US.name: RingCentral for Teams Desktop Plugin

zh-CN.description: 处理 RingCentral for Teams 嵌入式应用通话的无头插件。
zh-CN.longDescription:
RingCentral for Teams 嵌入式应用让您能够通过拨打电话、管理呼叫队列、查找联系人等功能与团队成员沟通协作。
主要功能包括：
- 在 Teams 桌面端及网页端应用中采用全新设计的用户体验
- 跨 RingCentral 与 Teams 通讯录的统一联系人搜索
- 集成短信与传真功能
- 未接来电、新短信及新语音邮件通知
- 支持在 Teams 内自定义 RingCentral 电话设置
